interfaces: Review crate module imports and signatures explicitly; Cargo alone cannot enforce intra-crate direction.
Use prepared locked dependencies; disconnect external services for test execution; no global executable/private data.
Inventory every planned test ID against cargo test -- --list, rejecting missing or zero-test evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned fmt, Clippy -D warnings, test, doc-test, and release build commands all pass without bypasses.
Private DTO/model construction, closed task dispatch, separate observation/scoring types, no foreign label indexes and no cloned opaque metric payloads are reviewed.
Every clause/conformance/structure row in the planning coverage map has actual accepted proof; no generic task completion substitutes for missing evidence.

verification.expected: All commands work on saved public inputs without network/credentials.

- Both task kinds use the same CLI operations, manifest, ID alignment, provenance,
  and artifact publication without duplicate implementations of those rules.

- Checked construction rejects cross-kind targets, probabilities, and policies;
  evaluator signatures prevent cross-kind input at compile time.

- Reordering submitted label sets preserves scores and canonical report ordering;
  duplicate labels fail before any conversion to a set.

- Marginals such as `[0.9,0.8]` remain valid and unchanged; the same numbers are
  invalid as a categorical distribution.

- Empty set, abstention, missing row, and missing marginal key take four distinct
  paths with the required evidence or error.
- Restricting a run to zero episodes retains probability applicability.

- Evidence-bearing abstentions retain distributions and observations. Probability
  metrics use the selected population; confidence/correctness diagnostics use raw
  answered episodes and disclose their included/excluded IDs.

- Observed categorical `[0.5,0.49]` is retained without normalization; the same
  vector in a scoring field fails validation. No implicit observation-to-signal
  conversion or error-recovery path is available.

- Scalar and auxiliary observations round-trip with their definitions and source
  references but do not generate unsupported target types or metrics.
- Broken observation definitions and preparation bindings fail before scoring.

- Per-label counts do not replace episode records: equal aggregate counts can
  coexist with different exact-set accuracy.

- Unsupported counts, mixed task kinds, partial labels, and per-label abstentions
  are rejected without adding extension hooks or inferred interpretations.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
